storyboard:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one finished cinematic art-direction storyboard for KENZAKI's interactive 3D portfolio, a wide 2-by-2 board of four equal film frames with thin black gutters, not a website screenshot.
Input image 1 is ONLY the exact Kinetic K brand geometry reference; preserve this angular monogram and its small cyan accents when it appears. It is not a background or an edit target.
Primary request: Establish a genuinely premium, visually distinctive, cohesive cinematic world, worthy of a high-end architectural film and luxury creative studio. Every frame belongs to the SAME fictional atelier and continuous camera journey. The quality benchmark is physically convincing architectural visualization and premium product-film art direction, with refined composition, intricate material detail, filmic exposure, intentional negative space, and controlled depth of field. This is a visual target for an interactive website, not a claim that it is already implemented.
World: monumental yet intimate graphite-stone atelier at blue hour. Sculptural curved brushed-metal ribs, dark honed basalt, smoked optical glass, a narrow distant opening onto a misty coastal horizon. Restrained cyan brand accents meet soft warm architectural side lighting. A few subtle suspended planes and carefully shaped light, never a cluttered corridor of monitors. Light haze only where physically plausible. Floor is selectively polished, with soft imperfect reflections rather than a perfect mirror.
Frame 1 / upper left: wide 35mm entrance establishing shot, camera low at human eye level. The original K monogram is a beautifully machined, thick, subtly beveled metal sculpture integrated into the right half of the space, suspended just above a dark stone surface, with small cyan inlays. Rich grazing light reveals real microtexture. Spacious, near-black negative space on the left for future HTML typography. No text baked into this image.
Frame 2 / upper right: extreme macro tracking shot through the same K's beveled junction, brushed grain, fine machining marks, a narrow cyan light seam, spectacular restrained specular highlights, soft depth of field, a glimpse of the atelier beyond through the geometric opening. It should imply a camera transition from material detail into the world, not a second unrelated object.
Frame 3 / lower left: the camera has traveled inside the same atelier and reveals one monumental angled floating display plane and two quiet recessed companion planes, sculptural architecture framing them. Displays show only tasteful abstract editorial compositions and luminous gradients, no fake brand names, fake metrics, text, faces, or invented client work. These are placeholders for the user's real website and video work to be composited later. Strong spatial depth, clean hierarchy, warm/cool lighting continuity.
Frame 4 / lower right: a quieter, warmer alcove reached through the same architectural language. A restrained large exhibition plane and smaller certificate-sized plane float within soft sculptural walls, reserved for the user's real speaking photo and certificate later. Keep them abstract/blank, do not generate people or certificates. The scene feels human, assured, calm, and connected to the opening shot, with a clear space for readable story text.
Color: near-black graphite, natural silver, smoked glass, restrained ice cyan, warm pale amber, subtle atmospheric blue-hour sky. Filmic blacks with readable shadow detail, soft highlight rolloff, no blown-out neon.
Constraints: Four beautifully composed cinematic frames, physically plausible materials and perspective, strong visual continuity. No UI chrome, no navigation, no fake website text, no watermarks, no brands other than the referenced K symbol. Do not reproduce the previous simple grey plinth-and-glowing-circle gallery. Avoid glowing rings, generic sci-fi tunnels, gaming aesthetics, low-poly geometry, cheap chrome blobs, stock business imagery, overdone particles, excessive bloom, flat poster compositions, or a grid of cards.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable base-color material texture for real-time 3D architectural stone. Generate a square orthographic close-up material scan, edge-to-edge without borders, of extremely refined dark graphite basalt/honed volcanic stone. The surface should have photorealistic tiny irregular mineral pores, subtle charcoal tonal variation, faint fine grain and shallow natural micro-fissures. Keep the scale restrained and premium: no giant cracks, large repeating rock shapes, marble swirls, writing, framing, or objects. Material is suitable for the graphite architecture in a luxury cinematic atelier. Neutral diffuse even scan lighting only, no baked cast shadows, no light direction, no specular highlights, no vignette, no perspective, no ambient room or floor. Seamless repeatable pattern with matching edges, approximately 1 meter by 1 meter material coverage, high microtexture detail, grayscale charcoal palette with readable variation. This is a usable albedo/base-color bitmap, not a scene rendering or a PBR contact sheet. One texture only.

Uniform neutral diffuse scan illumination, no baked gradients, no studio softbox reflections, no directional highlights, no cast shadows, no vignette, no object edges, no perspective, no text or borders.
